corrections: The previous compiler error occurred because the system model attempted to write B6.thermalInventory and B7.thermalInventory from outside SimpleTank even though those variables were protected. More importantly, that attempted fix represented cooling by directly differentiating another model's internal state, which breaks the component boundary and the stated one-writer discipline for states. This bundle removes all external writes to protected/internal tank inventories.

The previous controller also did not faithfully realize the required parallel split and join: it used a single mode progression that never entered the B7 branch after evaporation. This revision keeps the sequential front end (Idle through Step6) and then tracks condensate and concentrate branch completion with separate discrete branch status variables during the post-evaporation phase, preserving the required split/rejoin structure in one controller.

Evidence for full condensate branch sub-steps is incomplete in the brief. This model therefore keeps only evidence-grounded condensate branch behavior: B6 cooling to TIS-602 <= 20 before P2 return, with approved current routing on the P2 branch retained from the brief.

The brief gives benchmark cooling duties (-6500 W and -4500 W) and a heater Q_flow relation of 20000 when on, but it does not provide the complete thermophysical property set and approved executable equations needed for a physically rigorous WaterNaCl mass-energy model in this bundle. This returned executable therefore remains a signal-flow surrogate rather than an acausal two-phase medium model.
